notes: Both styles encoded from the Newmac page text. Counting verified for style 2: character counting gives a valid decode (month 02, day 18, year 93) while digit-only counting is falsified (it would give month 18). Page discrepancy flagged: the style 2 example is listed as NL2 021803 D 036000 but detailed as NL2 021893 D 036000; the detailed (bold date-code) form is used as the example. Both forms decode validly under the same positions (2003 vs 1993), so the pattern and positions are unaffected by the discrepancy. Day is stated on the page but the schema has no day field, so it is not encoded.

styles.notes: Page example serial. Month = 1st-2nd characters (07), day = 3rd-4th (15), year = 5th-6th (08 = 2008).

Detailed page example (NL2 021893 D 036000, spaces removed by normalization). Month = 4th-5th characters (02), day = 6th-7th (18), year = 8th-9th (93 = 1993). The list form NL2 021803 D 036000 differs in one digit and is flagged in the brand notes, not encoded as a separate example.
